title: Wire feature toggles into scaffold options
description: Pass the user's feature toggle selections (auth, email, PDF renderer) from NewProjectWizard through to scaffold.ts. scaffold.ts should conditionally include or exclude feature-specific files.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature toggle selections from wizard are passed to scaffold() as options
Selecting auth:false causes auth-related files to be excluded from the scaffolded project
Selecting email:false causes email-related files to be excluded
Scaffolded project files match the user's selections

steps.description: Pass wizard results to scaffold in new.ts
steps.details: In the NewProjectWizard onComplete callback (in new.ts), extract { type, features } and call scaffold(type, projectName, destPath, features).

steps.description: Implement feature file exclusion in scaffold.ts
steps.details: In scaffold.ts, after processTemplate completes, check options for each feature. If auth is false, delete auth-related files (e.g., server/src/middleware/auth.ts, server/src/routes/auth.ts). Use a featureFiles map to define which files belong to each feature.

In scaffold.ts, define: const featureFiles = { auth: ['server/src/middleware/auth.ts', 'server/src/routes/auth.ts', 'server/src/lib/jwt.ts'], email: ['server/src/lib/mailer.ts', 'server/src/routes/email.ts'], pdf: ['server/src/lib/pdf.ts'] }. Use fs.remove() to delete each file if the feature is disabled.
Scaffold a webapp with auth:false into a temp directory. Confirm auth-related files are not present. Scaffold another with auth:true and confirm they are present.

technicalNotes: fs-extra's fs.remove() is safe to call on non-existent files (it resolves without error)
Feature files must be templated in the webapp template even if they'll be deleted — deletion happens post-copy
